direct_risk_subgraph_rationale: The subgraph includes node-deep-equal and node-parse-json as they are the primary sources of explicit textual conflict regarding ABI states and migration. node-es-abstract is included because it forms a direct cycle with node-deep-equal, highlighting structural fragility around one of the conflicting nodes. node-read-pkg is included as it directly depends on node-parse-json and is part of the path where node-parse-json's ABI management rules apply. node-istanbul is included as it depends on node-read-pkg and is thus further along the path influenced by node-parse-json. node-tape is included as it acts as a nexus, depending directly on node-deep-equal and indirectly on node-parse-json (via node-istanbul -> node-read-pkg), thus connecting the two conflicting elements and serving as a point where the inconsistency could manifest. This set is minimal because removing any node would break the representation of the direct textual conflict, the structural cycles involving the conflicting nodes, or the connection between the two conflicting nodes and their respective dependency paths.
